test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 12 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence with the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

options.text: The team worked hard to complete the project.
We visited several historical sites during our trip.
She enjoyed the delicious dinner and dessert.
The hotel room was very clean and comforble.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"comforble"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be "comfortable." (आरामदायक)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** Providing physical ease and relaxation; free from stress or discomfort.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** आरामदायक
 
• **Example:** The sofa in the living room is very comfortable to sit on.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"comfortable."**
 
 
• **English Meaning:** Providing physical ease and relaxation; free from stress or discomfort.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** आरामदायक
 
• **Example:** The hotel provided comfortable accommodations during our stay.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The team worked hard to complete the project. (टीम ने परियोजना को पूरा करने के लिए कड़ी मेहनत की।)

 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** कोई गलत वर्तनी नहीं है।
 
• **Example:** The team showed great dedication while completing the project.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** We visited several historical sites during our trip. (हमने अपनी यात्रा के दौरान कई ऐतिहासिक स्थलों का दौरा किया।)
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** कोई गलत वर्तनी नहीं है।
 
• **Example:** The Taj Mahal is one of the historical sites we visited during our trip.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** She enjoyed the delicious dinner and dessert. (उसने स्वादिष्ट रात के खाने और मिठाई का आनंद लिया।)
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** कोई गलत वर्तनी नहीं है।
 
• **Example:** The chocolate cake was the perfect dessert after dinner.
